name: Itou Souta
source:
Souta is a second year high school student and a member of the light music club, playing the guitar. He likes motorcycles and his car, which is a Suzuki Katana. 
He used to be a simple young man who started living alone in an apartment after moving to Tokyo, but his daily life changed completely after he was bitten by a vampire. To regain his humaninty Souta will devote himself to extraordinary battles during the last two weeks remaining before the point of no return.
